notes.title: v1.7.0.1399 - Controller UPDATE & Feedback from PAX/REZZED
notes.notes:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/p040esuhQx9Go/giphy.gif[/img]

We recently took MetaMorph to PAX East in Boston and Rezzed in London where we got a chance to demo controller support for the first time.  The feedback was very positive so we are super excited be in a position to add it to the main game.  This is a first pass so there are a few rough edges which we will be working on in the coming weeks.  As always we want your feedback.

Thanks to everyone that came to the shows and played MetaMorph.  After observing folks playing the demo and talking to them afterwards we have implemented a number of fixes based on that feedback.  Thanks also to Grimm for his valuable feedback.  We will be adding more of your suggestions soon!

[b][i]v1.7.0.1399 - 33.8MB - Controller Support 2nd Pass[/i][/b]

[b]Controller Tweaks and Other Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved skill targeting using controllers
[*]Fixed the level map scrolling to latest unlocked level when completing previous levels using controller
[*]Improved spawn hole animations
[*]Fixed spawning as the incorrect hero from checkpoints
[*]Scene loading optimizations
[*]Fixed an exploit to 'spring' heroes forward by canceling targeted skills
[*]Improved Poison Bomb explosions
[*]Improved Rabbit's 'Ghost' animations
[*]Fixed a bug where the rabbit would move while crouched after landing
[*]Menu button optimizations
[*]Improved ultimate ability effects for all Heroes
[/list]


[b][i]v1.6.0.1375 - 69.1MB - Controller Support 1st Pass & Feedback from PAX/REZZED[/i][/b]

[b]Controller Support[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28288497/df5844dcdd89d7c6a861418c2506fb1e4a979210.png[/img]

This is our first pass at controller support and as such is not feature complete. Here are some notes on controller support for the moment:

- Working/optimized for Xbox 360/XB1 gamepads, Steam Controller and 3rd party controllers with similar layouts
- Not currently compatible with DualShock4 (even with DS4Windows). We'll get to it eventually.
- All heroes attack automatically, targeting the closest enemy in range.
- Targeted skills (Rabbit's 'Jump', Nymph's 'Fire Strike' etc) are a bit fiddly at the moment but we're working on them.
- Settings menus, loadout screen and level map screen still have teething issues and as such are not perfect but do have basic functionality
- In game controls can be viewed in the Settings menu under Controller
- Only one control scheme for now. Others to come in future updates.
- In map screen, use LT/RT to switch between Map screen and Loadout screen. Press Start to open Main Menu.
- Loadout screen shows contextual button prompts for assigning skills and heroes, as well as buying skill points and upgrading.


[b]Tweaks and Fixes[/b]

- Added a delay to enemies' reactivating after Ratman cloak skill
- Pots now have a 25% chance of spawning a small gold pile when destroyed
- Fire jets now emit a small fire spurt before igniting
- Ogre's ultimate skill can now be directed.  About time!
- Improved poison blobs
- New machine gun turret graphics and animation
- New flamethrower animation
- New lava texture
- Increased distance of Butcher's charge
- Picture of hero and skills added to messages
- New enemy spawning effect
- Added a particle to hero and UI when ultimate skill is available
- The Butcher is now attackable while spinning
- The Butcher should now rotate more reasonably while spinning
- The Butcher stands up on the spot when recovering after charging into a wall, so his attack point doesn't have to move again
- New Fire Golem model and Lava Crack attack
- Fire Golem rebalanced to make him WELL 'ARD
- Fixed a bug where the Golem would rotate to face the player while resting
- Fixed a bug with the cloak skill not triggering its cooldown
- Various sfx tweaks
- Various small gameplay tweaks and bug fixes


[b]Please note:[/b] This update should download automatically when you launch the Steam client. You can check the version number on the dungeon map screen. If it's not correct please exit and re-login to Steam.

notes.title: v1.5.0.1235 - New Hero! New Traps! New Levels! New Enemies! New Boss!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/914667236468722530/CD7C634BFA3353F30610D7380426770D9E581D66/[/img]

In this update we are introducing the first new hero to MetaMorph - The Ratman! The Ratman is fast but weak so has to use his cunning and guile to serve up silent, creeping death. notes.title: Spanish, Russian and Polish now available!
notes.notes:
Today we released 3 more languages for MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures. The game can now be played in English, German, French, Spanish, Russian or Polish.

[b][i]v1.4.0.1059[/i][/b]

[b]Features[/b]
- Three new localized languages
- Español (Spanish)
- Русский (Russian)
- Polski (Polish)

To change your in-game language, please right-click on MetaMorph in your Steam Library and go to Properties > Language

If you spot anything that doesn't look correct in your chosen language such as incorrect/missing letters, text overruns, bad translations please let us know in the forum.

[b]Please note:[/b] This update should download automatically when you launch the Steam client. You can check the version number on the dungeon map screen. If it's not correct please exit and re-login to Steam.

notes.title: Monsters, Traps & Levels
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28288497/869fbf6fba28db48db5a05d2b9fd40b95c632e50.gif[/img]

[b]HAPPY NEW YEAR![/b]

We're kicking off 2018 with a glimpse at our immediate plans for [i]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/i]. This week's video gives you a sneak peek at our first content update due later this month, while also hinting at things to come! This smaller update is our first piece of Early Access content so please let us know what you think of the new additions:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m1RnHf7bvTc
Our first major update for MetaMorph will include a little of everything you like about the game so far:
[list]
    [*][b]More Monsters[/b] - The Wraith arrives in MetaMorph in three different elemental flavors and later on as a challenging mini-boss!
    [*][b]Extra Levels[/b] - 10 new dungeons will push your morphing, hacking and slashing to the test with new threats hiding around every corner...
    [*][b]New Traps[/b] - Get ready to run away from, dodge and jump over large destructive boulders.
[/list]
Our first update will also come with smaller fixes and improvements as we play with the different elements and challenges on offer, along with the concept of mini-bosses. New traps pose both immediate and long term danger, alongside whatever else happens to be trying to kill you at the time. So put your abilities to good use and perhaps you can avoid choking to death! We'll also be adding a new hero ability for the Rabbit and more in future updates!

We hope you enjoy what you’ve seen of MetaMorph so far and look forward to our second, larger content update coming in the near future!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/606870/MetaMorph_Dungeon_Creatures/

notes.title: Now Available on Early Access
notes.notes:
[h1]3 Heroes, 11 Abilities, 5 Traps, 50 Levels and 1 Demonic Butcher![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w1kytzL8uwg
⇪⇪⇪ [b]NEW LAUNCH TRAILER[/b] ⇪⇪⇪

It gives us great pleasure to finally release our tactical dungeon crawler onto Steam Early Access! [i]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/i] is our third original IP as a studio and first ever game to break into the realm of action-strategy. To survive you must strategically morph between characters, counter enemy types and plan your attack as you advance deeper into the dungeon...
[list]
    [*][b]Transform Your Fate[/b] - Morph between the lightning fast Rabbit, brutish Ice Ogre and spectral Fire Nymph as you deal with unique enemy types and attack patterns.
    [*][b]Trap Your Enemies[/b] - Turn the dungeon against unsuspecting foes by leading them into the paths of vicious saw blades, incendiary powder bombs and colossal Skeleton Snakes.
    [*][b]Power Up[/b] - Acquire and level up unique powers for each hero, morphing at just the right time to chain together effective combos and elements.
    [*][b]Reclaim the Dungeon[/b] - Drive back the undead hordes and demonic forces that now claim the dungeon by rescuing the (mostly) innocent Goblins and clearing each floor.
[/list]
Our Early Access trailer should give you a good idea of what to expect from the game in its current form, which features a team of three heroes and plenty of challenging levels to conquer. Free updates will expand the roster of playable characters, add new enemy types, abilities and dungeon traps! As new content is added team composition and in particular skill loadouts will become increasingly important. To reach the lower dungeons you will need to figure out each level's puzzling mix of brutal traps and hellish enemies. So get ready to customise, level up and most importantly morph to survive!

We can't wait to hear what you think of the game in its current state and any suggestions you might have as we continue to work on [i]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/i] during Early Access. Check out our Early Access store page for information about the current version and our future plans. To join us on our Early Access adventure head over to the game's Steam forum or find us on social media for updates as we add new content.

notes.title: Firefly Dev Update
notes.notes:
[h1]MetaMorph, Stronghold Next & Stronghold Kingdoms![/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9vRQ6cJEiDs
Now that [i]Stronghold 2: Steam Edition[/i] is available, [i]Stronghold Kingdoms[/i] has arrived on mobile and [i]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/i] is rapidly approaching release we thought this would be a great time to update everyone on the state of play.

Watch as our very own Lead Designer Simon Bradbury and coders Matt and Jack update you on all things Firefly with a snapshot on production for each title currently in development:
[list]
    [*][b]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/b] - Coming Soon to Early Access
    [*][b]Stronghold Next[/b] [Working Title] - Now in Active Development
    [*][b]Stronghold Kingdoms[/b] - New Updates Planned!
[/list]
In the video above our three developers provide a quick update on each title including new gameplay, timelines and nuggets of information. As we look forward to the release of MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures on Steam Early Access and prep for full production and the reveal of Stronghold Next in 2018 this new video is designed to let you know exactly where we’re at.

While Stronghold Kingdoms is already available worldwide you can expect MetaMorph to release very soon, followed by a full reveal of Stronghold Next in the not too distant future. Our reveal of the next mainline entry in the Stronghold series will take place next year, including almost everything we can show at that stage and loads of information. Rather than a simple announcement in the form of a logo reveal you expect gameplay footage, the full title, setting, features and new units all in one go!

We hope you enjoy today’s video and look forward to playing these games and updates in the near future.

notes.title: New Trailer – Meet the Nymph
notes.notes:
[h1]New Gameplay and Early Access Abilities[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-cYjlwiVX1o
The final form in our trio of transformations available at launch, the Fire Nymph uses ranged attacks and her unique elemental type to dispatch the dungeon's countless traps and minions!

The Nymph is a ranged attacker with the ability to auto-target and incinerate enemies from a distance, assuming she's not backed into a corner! Her unique elemental type also gives the Nymph invulnerability against fiery traps and a boost against ice type enemies. Just beware the dungeons more poisonous monstrosities, as a spirit of nature the Nymph is weak against their corrupting spells and attacks.

Three of five special abilities the Nymph can unlock during the course of the full game are spotlighted in this new trailer:
[list]
    [*][b]Fire Strike[/b] - Heat the ceiling of the dungeon white-hot before sending incendiary molten rocks crashing down onto unsuspecting foes.
    [*][b]Multi-Shot[/b] - Dispatch distant, weaker monsters with a spinning attack that sends out a flurry of conjured auto-targeting fireballs.
    [*][b]Inferno[/b] - Charge the Nymph’s elemental powers to their peak before dispatching all nearby minions with a powerful AOE blast.
[/list]
As with the Rabbit, Ice Ogre and other heroes released both during and after Early Access, the Fire Nymph’s powers can be strung together with those of other morphs for maximum effect. Players will need to customise their loadouts, switch between heroes at the most opportune moment and manage cooldowns to survive and conquer each dungeon!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/fireflyworlds]Want more? Follow us on YouTube![/url]

notes.title: New Trailer - Meet the Ogre
notes.notes:
[h1]Ice Ogre Gameplay and Abilities[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AWaT75QQYZo
We're preparing for the Early Access release of our new character switching, class based dungeon crawler with the release of a new hero trailer!

‘The Ogre’ as he is simply known is the first spirit form players will acquire in-game, providing new strategic options as a brawling tank class character. An ancient force of nature returned to life for the battle against Death’s armies, the Ogre makes up for his slow speed with the ability to control and absorb damage from larger mobs of enemies.

This new trailer also spotlights three of five special abilities players will be able to select for the Ogre, as part of their unique loadout for each dungeon. The Knockback Smash very much does what it says on the tin, allowing players to crowd control all but the toughest opponents using the Ogre's colossal icy fist. Rock Fall send tremors through the dungeon, breaking loose heavy boulders from above to crush weaker enemies when surrounded. Lastly the Ogre's Roar ability harnesses ancient magic to freeze enemies, holding each threat in place and leaving them open to follow up attacks.

Each spirit form's powers are designed to be used in combination with each other, switching between different abilities and heroes at will to discover the most effective combos.

[b]Don't forget to wishlist [i]MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures[/i] on Steam![/b]

[url=https://www.youtube.com/fireflyworlds]Firefly Studios on YouTube[/url]

notes.title: MetaMorph: Dungeon Creatures
notes.notes:
[h1]Firefly Announces New Action Strategy Game[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HjkvXS6XPhk
Morph between spirit forms and crush hordes of evil minions! The Lords of Death have returned and with the green, fertile lands of the overworld under siege it’s up to you to take the fight beneath the earth. Liberate dungeons, free the spirits of fallen heroes and turn their powers against Death himself!

[list][*]MORPH between powerful spirit forms, shapeshifting to counter and crush enemy hordes.
[*]MASTER tactical combat in an adventure that rewards strategic choices over button mashing.
[*]EXPLORE hostile dungeons infested with demons, grotesque experiments and vengeful spirits.
[*]CUSTOMISE your heroes’ ability loadouts and team composition before braving each hellish lair.
[*]BANISH Death’s horde to the nether realm with each hero’s unique powers and attributes.[/list]
